blocks.x: Grocery runs on the thinnest margins and the shortest freshness clocks: ordering precision, waste reduction and store labor efficiency decide survival. Fresh-chain intelligence — demand by day-part, markdown automation, cold-chain truth — is the difference. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in fresh ordering, markdown management, cold-chain monitoring, with store labor scheduling close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
The places value leaks — Grocery & Convenience edition:

items: Day-part and weather-driven demand unmodeled; waste and OOS coexist.
Store ordering anchored to history; seasonal and local shifts missed.
Fridge/warehouse telemetry missing; spoilage and compliance risk hidden.
Markdown decisions by manager instinct; waste too high, margin too low.
Store payment estates and loyalty points under fraud pressure.
Refrigeration and HVAC costs unoptimized across hundreds of sites.
